anthropic/claude-opus-5-5.feedback: After moved `rejection` to holds by making the rejection outcome block explicit: it reports the push rejected once, states "Not retried, not forced", explicitly skips the body edit ("no body fetch, no scratch file, no `gh pr edit`"), says "Closure skipped", prints the exact phrase "Member PRs #13, #14 left open", preserves the worktree, and on return to the menu says no push retry or member-close question is offered. Before covered most of this but never mentioned the close question and used "Members #13 and #14 untouched" rather than the required left-open statement. `guards` held in both: both withhold row 1 on divergence, stop on #14 exit 1 with the ccccccc rewritten-history message, treat exit 128 as a command error, and keep rows 2-6 from closing members. To keep both facts while delivering the Change, retain After's outcome block wording (explicit "Closure skipped" plus "Member PRs #13, #14 left open") and the per-variant "left open" lines; one small risk in After is the ordering of ship steps—it shows the seal before mentioning the plan strip, so adding the `git rm` of the `**Spec:**` plan candidates before the seal (as Before did) would make the strip/seal narration match the Change without affecting either fact.
